QuestInfo.name: The Stump Horror Story
QuestInfo.0: #p506# of #m10004000# says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...
QuestInfo.1: I met #p506# in #m10004000#. She can't remember anything about her childhood and lives every day in fear of the #o6#s that surround Perion. She finds even looking at them too scary. Due to this paralyzing fear of #o6#s, Ayan can't take a single step out of #m10004000#, so she asked me to help her by thinning their numbers. Are they really THAT scary?
QuestInfo.2: I took out #o6#s for #p506#'s sake in #m10004000#. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!

0.0: Excuse me. I know it's rude to ask a stranger, but can you please help me out? I'm terrified of the #o6#s that are wandering around outside this town and can't leave because of them. I can't even make eye contact with them without being scared to death. Please, if you have some time on your hands, can you help me out?

yes.0: Thank you so much. I knew you would say yes. As you can see, I am not from the tribes here. According to the elders, they found me lost in the streets years ago, all bruised up and messy.
yes.1: The elders saved me, and I have been living here ever since. Unfortunately, I don't remember anything from the past. Something might have happened back then.
yes.2: I think I can't remember my past because I went through something so horrible that my head chose to block it all out. Maybe that's why I'm so scared of #o6#s. Can you do me a favor and take out some #r#o6#s#k please?

no.0: You must be busy. If you find some spare time later on, please come by and talk to me.

1.0: Wow, thank you so much! I don't see as many #o6#s near #m10004000# now! I feel like I can finally take a step outside. Thank you so much for your hard work!

mob.0: I don't think you've gotten all the #r#o6#s#k yet. Please help me; I want to be able to go out of town as soon as I can.
